messages:
maya: Quick sync — I scribbled a priority score for the new model candidate (mistral-v2-25b-opt). Can people skim and drop a 1-5 for Quality/Latency/Cost/Risk? Link: https://rwd.internal/notes/model-intake-2026 :eyes:
liam: Scored it locally. Quality 4 (good on our eval set), Latency 2 (big), Cost 2. Risk 3 (quantization unknown). Will add a short note in the doc.
sophia: FYI automated eval gave:
```
answer_quality: +0.07 (vs baseline)
pii_detection: 0.00
toxicity: -0.01
ppl(valid): 12.3 vs 13.7 (better)
latency(1k tokens): 420ms on A100
```
so quality looks promising but latency is a concern.
arjun: From roadmap/BU perspective this would unlock reranking use-case for Search v2 (high value). I lean to bumping priority even if infra work needed.
maya: Proposed rubric snippet (weights in parentheses):
- Quality (0.4)
- Latency (0.2)
- Cost (0.15)
- Reliability/Rollout risk (0.15)
- Security & Compliance (0.1)
Example calc: Quality 4, Latency 2, Cost 2, Risk 3, Security 5 => priority score = 4*0.4 + 2*0.2 + 2*0.15 + 3*0.15 + 5*0.1 = 2.6
Suggest threshold: >=3.0 => fast-track; 2.2-3.0 => sprint backlog; <2.2 => low.
eval-bot: Automated regression check: model mistral-v2-25b-opt -> overall: PASS but flagged -3 pts on long-form factuality regression (dataset: news-eval-2025). Full report: https://rwd.internal/evals/1769004321
liam: Plan: spin int4 quant experiment and a KV-cache perf run. If int4 adds <=15% quality drop but halves cost, it's worth dedicated capacity. Who can own the int4 experiments?
sophia: I can kick off quant runs Tuesday. Will run: baseline fp16, q4, q8 + eval harness for factuality and QA reg tests. Will post results in thread.
arjun: Ops question — do we have spare GPUs next sprint? This might need dedicated capacity for stable perf measurement.
ops-bot: HEADS-UP: reserved pool has one A100 slot free week of 1769008000-1769016000. For stable runs recommend requesting dedicated slot via /reserve-prod-gpu.
maya: Action items: 1) Sophia -> quant + eval runs (due Tue EOD). 2) Liam -> latency microbench + KV-cache profiling (due Wed). 3) Arjun -> confirm BU impact + tentative commit if score >=3.0. 4) Ops -> reserve slot if we decide fast-track. We'll reconvene Friday 11am PT for final prioritization. :calendar:
